answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. KL 0.124 is within the fine-tuned range (0.081-0.205) and well above the quantized range (0.039-0.071) and below system-prompted (0.197-0.339). Top-1 agreement of 0.939 sits at the top edge of fine-tuned (0.900-0.938) and just above it, close to the quantized range (0.945-0.955). Sequence agreement of 0.625 fits fine-tuned (0.47-0.64) rather than quantized (0.67-0.70). TV of 0.076 is the lower bound of fine-tuned (0.076-0.099), and quantized is lower at 0.048-0.055. Token-DiFR gap of 0.114 matches fine-tuned (0.10-0.31) and is above quantized (0.03-0.04). Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero. Quantized is the closest alternative, but KL, TV and DiFR all exceed its ranges.
